footnote_text: On June 11, 2026, the Issuer acquired the private Delaware corporation which was then known as Azora Therapeutics, Inc. ("Old Azora") in accordance with the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated June 11, 2026 ("Merger Agreement"), by and among the Issuer, Adial Merger Sub, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of the Issuer ("First Merger Sub"), Adial Second Merger Sub, LLC, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Issuer ("Second Merger Sub"), and Old Azora. || Under the terms of the Merger Agreement, on June 11, 2026, First Merger Sub merged with and into Old Azora, with Old Azora surviving the first merger as a wholly owned subsidiary of the Issuer, and immediately following the first merger, Old Azora merged with and into Second Merger Sub, with Second Merger Sub surviving the second merger as a wholly owned subsidiary of the Issuer (such mergers, collectively the "Merger"). Upon the closing of the Merger, shares of outstanding common stock, Series A-1 Preferred Stock, Series A-2 Preferred Stock and Series A-3 Preferred Stock of Old Azora were converted into the right to receive shares of the Issuer's common stock ("Common Stock") and Series A Non-Voting Convertible Preferred Stock ("Series A Preferred Stock") in accordance with the Merger Agreement. || As previously reported, represents an award of restricted stock units ("RSUs"). On June 11, 2026, the Issuer's board of directors approved the RSUs to be issued on June 12, 2026, contingent on stockholder approval of the issuance of Common Stock upon conversion of the Series A Preferred Stock (the "Preferred Stock Conversion Proposal"). Stockholders approved the Preferred Stock Conversion Proposal on October 28, 2026 (the "Conversion Proposal Approval Date"). In addition, the RSUs' vesting terms were amended October 28, 2026 to provide that the RSUs vest as to 25% of the shares on the first anniversary of the grant date (June 12, 2026), with the remaining shares vesting in a series of 36 equal monthly installments thereafter, subject to the Reporting Person's continuous service through the applicable vesting date.
